verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud marketing names a built-in Grafana Assistant and Investigations among its AI-powered capabilities and promises understanding production systems through natural language, so a built-in assistant appears to exist. The evidence is only thin product-page copy and appears specific to Grafana Cloud. Nothing shows what tasks can actually be delegated to it. missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's task-delegation and agentic actions (e.g., building dashboards or running queries on the user's behalf), detail on scope and limits, availability outside Grafana Cloud, independent or hands-on corroboration.
